editorial:
Imagine waking up to the worst nightmare possible and finding your own daughter dead in the tub. That is where you meet David Bryson, a broken father who is just trying to survive the day. He joins a support group to deal with his grief, but his nights are filled with scary visions that won't leave him alone. Things get really weird when a group of mysterious women show up. They claim they can actually bring his daughter back to life, but as you will see, their help comes with a very scary price. The whole movie feels heavy and dark, making you feel David's pain while you wonder if these women are actually evil.

You will notice that the acting is the strongest part here, as David's sadness feels very real. The pacing starts a bit slow, but the twists in the second half really pick up the speed. If you love movies about occult secrets and dark deals, you should definitely give this one a try. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the dark details, or you can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you are a big horror fan, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move.
endingExplained: You find out that the women are not helping David, but are actually using him for a dark ritual. In the final scenes, it is revealed that bringing his daughter back requires a soul trade. David realizes the horror of his choice too late. The movie ends with a twist showing that the entity he brought back is not his daughter at all, but a demon wearing her face, leaving David trapped in a permanent nightmare.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves supernatural thrillers and stories about grief.
